controller_adapter_scope.metrics: controller profile_ncu.sh default compact V100 metrics; no custom --set or --metrics argument
controller_adapter_scope.clock_policy: none; no clock or power policy changes

analysis_selection.method: select the WMMA action from the emitted report after collection; collection itself is not kernel-filtered

limitations: The controller NCU adapter emits its compact default metric list, not the originally proposed full set.
The collection has no launch-count or kernel-name filter; report analysis selects the WMMA kernel after collection.
Volta PM-sampling timelines are unavailable and are not inferred from static averages.
Profiled durations are not used for performance comparisons; those use separate unprofiled controller timings.
